proposed.rationale: Catalog explicitly has students design and build full-stack web applications with reactive front-ends, web services, and databases in team projects, directly developing the web platform development skill distinctive to software engineers.

Catalog explicitly teaches classic HCI design tactics — need finding, heuristic evaluation, prototyping, and user testing — plus conceptual and visual design, which map directly onto the PM's distinctive user research, usability testing, and design-artifact skills.
